plan.summary: This 4-week block starts a 12-week off-camp build for boxing with Week 1 used to establish training maxes before percentage-based work begins in Week 2. The block emphasizes general strength first, supported by simple explosive work and short accessories that fit around higher sparring load and 45-minute sessions.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Establish training maxes, build full-body strength, and keep power work crisp without adding unnecessary fatigue.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress the main lifts and explosive work while trimming any volume that clashes with sparring quality.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it through faster, sharper power and speed work.

exercises.name: 1a. Countermovement Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps and jump as high and fast as possible. Land quietly and stop if height drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Box Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a box height that lets you land in a strong athletic position.

exercises.name: 2. Front Squat
exercises.notes: Warm up with small jumps in load, then build to one hard clean set of 3-5 reps. This establishes your baseline for future percentage work.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then work up to your heaviest clean set of 3-5 reps. Log the load and reps so the app can estimate your training max.

substitutionOptions.name: Goblet Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use only if the front rack is limited. Make the top set hard but technically clean.
